def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    beginning_inventory_cost = 1250.00
    beginning_inventory_units = 200
    purchase_costs = [116.00, 440.00]
    purchase_units = [20, 80]
    units_sold = 10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_cost = beginning_inventory_cost + sum(purchase_costs)
    total_units = beginning_inventory_units + sum(purchase_units)
    weighted_average_cost_per_unit = total_cost / total_units
    answer = round(weighted_average_cost_per_unit * units_sold, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
